build_img2img_pipeline: build a StableDiffusionXLControlNetUnionImg2ImgPipeline with ControlNet and VAE for image-to-image generation
run_img2img_generation: run the pipeline to generate images from a prompt and control image using ControlNet Union

prepare_latents_from_image: prepare initial latents from an input image by encoding through the VAE
